page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top left. A catchword sits at the lower right below the last line. The right edge shows the neighbouring page, and a dark stain covers part of two lines.

main_text.p: peccando permittit ad hoc,ut definita illa pec-cati mensura suo demum tempore perficiatur. Progressus autem in peccando fit, non tantum cum unus aliquis pergit peccare, sed etiam pro-gressus fit,& paulatim impletur definita illa me-sura,cum posteri implent peccata parentum suo-rum. Complete,inquit Dominus,mensura pec-catorum patrum vestrorum,Matth.23 32 Scien-dum est,diversas esse peccatorum mensuras:Est enim mensura peccatorum omnium impiorum hominū,quotquot fuerunt unquâ,sunt,& futu-ri sunt ad ultimū usq; diem.de hac mensurâ jam diximus. Est deinde mensura peccatorum cer-tæ alicujus gentis & nationis, ut gentis Judæorū: de hac mensura& de impletione hujus mensu-ræ hic loquitur. Est denique mensura peccato-rū certæ alicujus personæ; de hac loquitur Apo-stolus Act.13.10. Non cessibis, inquit, invertere vias Domini rectas?Ut autem[?] peccatorum defi-nita est in Dei consilio mensura[?], sic quoq; alia-rum rerum quæ hominibus usuveniunt in hac vitâ;ut verbi causâ,gratiæ:Data est unicuiq;gra-tia secundum mensuram donationis Christi, Eph.4.7.ut afflictionum: Scientes easdem affli-ctiones à vestrâ, quæ in mundo est,fraternitate impleri,1.Pet.5.9.Etharum quoq; rerum diver-sę[?] considerantur mensurę.Vel enim mensura gratiæ & afflictionis quæ ad unum hominem[?] pertinet: vel mensura est istarum rerum,quæ[?] plures homines spectat. In ultimo autem die peccatorum impiorum,sic afflictionum piorum

page.notes: Stain over "mensura" in the line "in Dei consilio me...ra" and over "autem" in the line "Ut autem": readings marked [?]. "sę" in "diver-sę" and "considerantur sę" is doubtful. The line-end hyphen in "me-sura" may hide "men-"; the printing is hard to read there. The line-end words "hominem" and "quæ" are partly cut off at the right edge, so they are marked [?]. The right-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. Printed spellings kept: "Matth.23 32", "Act.13.10", "1.Pet.5.9", "Eph.4.7", "Judæorū", "taealicujus" (read as tæ alicujus). Stain at the lower left is not text.
